extract_bitext_from_wikimatrix: extract bitext pairs from a WikiMatrix tsv.gz file into separate source and target language files
filter_bitext_by_threshold: filter bitext pairs from a mined tsv.gz file using a margin score threshold
limit_bitext_by_sentence_count: extract bitext pairs limited to a maximum number of sentences from a tsv.gz file
limit_bitext_by_word_count: extract bitext pairs limited by maximum total words in source or target language
run_extract_cli: run the extract.py CLI tool with --tsv, --bitext, --src-lang, and --trg-lang arguments
